children: The Nasdaq Composite (COMP:IND) ended the week at 26,511.01, up 92.72 points, or 0.35%, on Friday, as technology stocks recovered from a midweek selloff as Treasury yields topped 5% and oil prices remained above $100 a barrel.
The index came under pressure on Wednesday after the Federal Reserve raised its policy rate by 25 basis points, its first rate increase since 2023.
Among the biggest weekly gainers, Strategy

rose 17.52% as the SEC's Thursday decision granted temporary conditional relief allowing certain venues to facilitate trading in tokenized U.S. stocks. The regulatory move also lifted other crypto-related stocks.

The cybersecurity stock was among software names that benefited after AI companies and executives raised concerns about slowing the development of increasingly powerful models, easing some investor concerns about the impact of AI on traditional software businesses.
